# Arova — B2B Lead Intelligence & Qualified Business Leads
> Curated B2B business prospect intelligence platform under the Arenova brand ecosystem.

Arova provides verified commercial business leads for service providers, agencies, and consultancies in India across five specialized domains. Leads include project scopes, estimated contract values, and verified decision-maker requirements with a 30-day exclusive outreach claim.

## Core Products & Capabilities
- **Business Lead Discovery:** Curated and human-verified commercial prospects actively seeking external service partners.
- **Strict 5 Approved Categories:**
  1. Programming & Software (custom web applications, APIs, SaaS architectures)
  2. Video Editing & Production (commercial video, motion design, YouTube post-production)
  3. Digital Marketing & SEO (performance marketing, search optimization, PPC ads)
  4. Website & E-commerce (Shopify 2.0, headless storefronts, conversion landing pages)
  5. Business Automation & AI (n8n/Zapier/Make workflows, CRM automation, AI integration)
- **Subscription Model:**
  - Starter Plan: ₹499 / 30 days (40 verified prospect allocations)
  - Growth Plan: ₹999 / 30 days (100 verified prospect allocations)
- **Privacy & Exclusivity Guarantee:**
  - 48-Hour Review Window: Prospect company identity is masked until accepted by subscriber to protect privacy.
  - 30-Day Exclusive Outreach: Once claimed, no other subscriber can view or claim the lead for 30 days.
